trial_court: Court of the learned I Additional District Judge, Kadapa, O.S.No.5 of 2001
case_name: D.Rukminamma And 4 Others, Rajampet ... vs D.Achamma, Chinna Chowak V Post, Kadapa ...

parties.respondent_defendant: D.Achamma, Chinna Chowak V Post, Kadapa (defendant)

facts_of_case: The parties are closely related. The appellants laid a suit for partition of properties and to allot shares against the respondents. Their claim was partly decreed while rejecting rest.

legal_principles.principle: The burden is on the plaintiffs to establish that there was a joint family constituted by Sri Doddapuneni Seshaiah Naidu, Sri Ramachandraiah and the defendants 2 to 4.
legal_principles.held: The burden is on the plaintiffs (appellants) to establish that there was a joint family constituted by Sri Doddapuneni Seshaiah Naidu, Sri Ramachandraiah and the defendants 2 to 4 (respondents 2 to 4) and that Sri Doddapuneni Seshaiah Naidu was its Kartha, managing all affairs of this joint family and its properties.

legal_principles.principle: Acquisition of any property by an individual member of a joint Hindu family cannot by itself partake the character and nature of the property belonging to joint Hindu family.
legal_principles.held: Acquisition of any property by an individual member of a joint Hindu family cannot by itself partake the character and nature of the property belonging to joint Hindu family.

legal_principles.principle: A member of coparcenary can bring his individual or self-acquired properties into the common hotchpot by process of blending along with other properties of the joint Hindu family.
legal_principles.held: A member of coparcenary can bring his individual or self-acquired properties into the common hotchpot by process of blending along with other properties of the joint Hindu family.
